# Heat equation

The temperature $u(x, t)$ in a rod satisfies

$$
\partial_t u = \alpha \nabla^2 u
$$

with diffusivity \(\alpha > 0\). In one dimension the fundamental solution is

\[
\Phi(x, t) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{4 \pi \alpha t}} \exp\left(-\frac{x^2}{4 \alpha t}\right)
\]
